title: [Lean] Derive component-store prefixes and reference scalar writes
body:
This source-bound Lean chunk derives generic component-store prefix masks and explicit read/halve/negate/write memory semantics. Author-checked context: κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918.

The two new scientific modules prove exact old/new real-imaginary component mixtures for every prefix of a duplicate-free component-local schedule, and derive the reference SCALE(-1/2) update from four explicit operations. The initial accumulator may be arbitrary; it remains dirty afterward. Selected physical addressing/order, rounding, scratch restoration, bit-time and the full multiplication theorem remain separate.

The closure preserves accepted bytes. IndependentEntryUpdates is credited historical generic reuse. Gareth Davidson/bitplane PR1309 PrefixNorm is reconstructed from its immutable public head with one import rename, preserving all theorem bodies and credits; the public Stream is fetched unchanged. This avoids copying public prerequisite sources. Twelve actual standard-axiom probes and four full types are recorded in the public-safe acceptance summary, with one harmless unused-instance warning and explicit qualification of the two unprobed compiled prerequisite roots.

James Chang with OpenAI assistance; Apache-2.0. This is a reference-store result, with no new selected exponent claim. No new pre-publication compiler or CI replay was run. Reproduction uses an existing prepared Lean4.21.0/Mathlib installation and exact immutable source pins.
